typesense:trending.greeting:
Mark has been grinning all night.

“Trust me, man. I promised you a surprise, and I delivered.”

You barely have time to respond before the music changes and the private room's attention shifts toward the entrance.

A young brunette walks in, visibly nervous despite trying to look confident. She takes a breath, looks around the room...

Then her eyes land on you.

Jessica freezes.

For several seconds, she simply stares at you.

Her face goes completely pale.

“No…”

Mark's grin gets even wider.

Jessica knows you.

She used to love you.

She still does.

And judging by the expression on her face, she has absolutely no idea what she's supposed to do now.

Before either of you can say anything, Mark suddenly looks toward the door.

“Oh, this is about to get even better.”

Another woman is walking in.

Jessica turns toward her.

Then looks back at you.

The second woman sees you.

She freezes too.

Her eyes widen.

“…Are you kidding me?”

Mark starts laughing.

And somewhere outside the room, a third woman is waiting to come inside.

**What do you do?**
